sections.text:
check_planet_employment - Immediately runs a job evaluation on the colony, firing and employing pops as needed
check_planet_employment = yes
Supported Scopes: planet ship colony

create_pop_group - Creates a new pop group based on an existing one with overrides. If no existing pop group is passed, species is mandatory.
create_pop_group = {
	pop_group = <base pop group> (optional; if omitted, species is required)
	species = last_created / <target> / random (optional; if omitted, base pop group is required)
	ethos = { ethic = <key> } / random (optional; if no base group and no ethic is provided, ethos will be randomized)
	category = <pop category> (optional; if omitted and no base group is defined, use category from first assigned job)
	size = <number> (optional, default: POP_BULK_UNIT_SIZE)
	random = <number> (optional) If set, the amount will be randomized in [max(0, size - random), size + random].
	growth_category = <key> (optional, default: 'GROWTH_CAT_OTHER')
	effect = <init effect> (optional)
}
Supported Scopes: planet ship colony

add_modifier - Adds a specific modifier to the scoped object for a set duration
add_modifier = {
	modifier = <key>
	days/months/years = <int, -1 (default) means it never expires>
	multiplier = <float>/<variable> (optional)
	time_multiplier = <variable> (optional: days/months/years value is multiplied by the value of this variable)
	clear_on_owner_change = yes (optional: default no; clears modifier if planet/system/megastructure's owner changes)
}
Supported Scopes: megastructure planet country ship pop pop_group fleet galactic_object pop_faction federation starbase spy_network espionage_operation astral_rift cosmic_storm_influence_field colony

remove_all_buildings - Removes all buildings from the scoped colony
remove_all_buildings = yes
Supported Scopes: planet ship colony

remove_all_districts - Removes all districts from the scoped colony
remove_all_districts = yes
Supported Scopes: planet ship colony

remove_building - Removes a single instance of a specific building from the scoped colony
	remove_building = <building_type_key>
Supported Scopes: planet ship colony

num_owned_colonies - Checks the country's or sector's number of owned colonies (includes both planet and ship colonies)
num_owned_colonies < 8
Supported Scopes: country sector

is_capital - Checks if the colony is its owner's capital
is_capital = yes
Supported Scopes: planet ship colony

is_situation_type - Checks if the scoped situation is a certain type.
is_situation_type = my_situation_type
Supported Scopes: situation

fixture_version: formal 0.2.1 production bytes plus isolated speed input fixtures
expected_examples_boundary: Paper expected values only; never written into the game by the fixture. Need observed J and three native monthly deltas.
runtime_required: Three monthly progress deltas at constant n and J
Stage boundaries and normal building costs separately
